notes: Read SKILL.md, references/aws-modules.md and references/oci-modules.md in full. Patterns for writing reusable Terraform modules: directory layout, an AWS VPC module (main/variables/outputs), module composition, a Terratest example, best practices, and bullet-list outlines of AWS and OCI module contents.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access are instructed; the skill shapes the user's own Terraform code. The Terratest sample (SKILL.md:235-245) would run `terraform apply` and `destroy` against the user's real cloud account if the user runs `go test`, so it should be pointed at a sandbox account.
`source = "../../modules/aws/..."` (SKILL.md:187, 206) are paths in the user's own module repository, not links to files outside the skill. No external file dependencies.
